items.text: ETR final Sunday injury board lists Saquon Barkley OUT (with DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown, Tank Bigsby). Schefter/Rapoport corroborate Eagles official ruling for London game vs JAX.
items.why: Official Eagles ruling Friday; hamstring issues.
items.implication: Eagles backfield and WR corps thinned significantly for London game.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining Eagles RBs/WRs/TEs (e.g. Gainwell, Goedert now IN).

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT on ETR board. Schefter notes Ravens also OUT Trey Hendrickson and Cam Jurgens; Huntley expected to start vs ATL.
items.implication: Major downgrade to Ravens offense/pass game; Flowers remains Q.
items.opportunity: Huntley start opens some rushing/streaming QB angles; Likely/Andrews usage watch.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (with AD Mitchell) on ETR Sunday board. Continues quad issues keeping him out of practice.
items.why: Quad; missed practice since Week 3 injury.
items.implication: Jets RB1 role to backup (Braelon Allen start expected).
items.opportunity: Clear path for Jets remaining RBs in expanded carries/snaps.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (plus OT Joe Alt, S Derwin James). Matches ETR OUT list.
items.implication: LAC WR targets consolidate to McConkey (Q) and others.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for remaining Chargers WRs if McConkey limited.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (off final injury report) despite ankle maintenance. Full participant Friday.
items.why: Ankle maintenance; coach notes trending right, not on final report.
items.implication: Clears path for primary Cardinals RB role vs DET.
items.opportunity: Projected workload lead; reverse any Allgeier stash emphasis.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins both QUESTIONABLE (Chase concussion protocol context; Higgins groin/neck). Messy Sunday morning expected. Berry notes Gesicki upside if either out.
items.implication: CIN pass-game pie fragmentation risk; monitor morning reports.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated targets to remaining WRs/TEs (Gesicki, Meyers).

items.text: Mike Evans off 49ers injury report with no designation (Juszczyk and Bosa OUT). Expected to play vs SEA.
items.why: No designation after practicing through ribs.
items.implication: Full WR1 role available for SF vs SEA.
items.opportunity: Normal routes/targets expected; warrior play anticipated.

items.text: Levitan on Love ankle: tough projection spot after Week 4 usage criticism. Gut says much better role this week; currently 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Accounts for downside if long year hits.
items.why: Not on final IR; media/fan pressure on prior usage; maintenance only.
items.implication: Strong RB2 projection lead if full-go; monitor snap share vs Allgeier.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries/routes expected vs prior week; goal-line upside.
items.conflict: Prior low usage creates variance risk if ankle limits.

items.text: Broncos place emerging WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR (ankle from vs 49ers). Misses next four; return window Nov 8 vs CAR. Schefter notes Humphrey promoted.
items.implication: DEN WR depth thinned; Humphrey to active roster.
items.opportunity: More snaps/targets for remaining Broncos receivers (Sutton, etc.).

items.text: D'Andre Swift has no injury designation for Sunday at GB despite missing some practice (hip/knee). Kyle Monangai ruled OUT.
items.implication: CHI RB lead role locked; Monangai absence consolidates work.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry share expected vs GB.

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk for Malik Nabers later season: sore knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) style. Frustrated over second-half targets Week 4.
items.why: Knee/shoulder health + QB/coaching variance; expressed frustration.
items.implication: Longer-term caution despite talent; monitor practice/usage closely.
items.opportunity: Target share risk if coaching boomers or QB change.

items.text: Berry LOVES Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8. Volume + red-zone + DvP matchup (Titans inflate WR scoring); excellent spot on return.
items.why: Target hog volume including RZ; soft TEN matchup; HOU implied points high.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; upgrade in rankings.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5. Workload + matchup vs defense carved by RBs; ties to potential CIN WR injuries boosting checkdowns.
items.why: Solid workload hard to ignore; soft MIA run D; Bengals injury spillover.
items.opportunity: Carries + potential pass-game bump if Chase/Higgins limited.
items.conflict: Levitan xFP notes underperformance on opportunities YTD.

items.text: Berry HATES Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle + matchup/role) and Mark Andrews (TE17, thin role/usage numbers). Also fades Cam Skattebo and Tony Pollard on efficiency/game script.
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, poor efficiency/usage data; Addison injury note.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats; lower rankings.
